note: McLean County park on 925-acre Evergreen Lake near Hudson. Sites 1-33 stay open all winter with electric; sites 34-126, the shower house and the campground water run April 1 to November 1, weather permitting. A camper used November-March should be cold-weather rated. The walk-in sites (11 in the main campground, 16 at White Oak) are tent sites. --Claude
summary: County page read: 156 sites (106 electric 26x50A/80x30A, 23 non-electric, 27 walk-in), year-round on sites 1-33, CampLife booking (operator) with mid-April..mid-Oct window, 14 nights in 30, water spigots not for hookup (water false), showers/dump; rates $28/$25/$22 with $2 resident discount match stored; extra-person charge not on the page; lakefront doubtful.
flags: WATERFRONT: recommend lakefront -> lakeview. On Esri imagery the west row of the main campground (~40.6447,-89.0331) sits 20-50 m from Evergreen Lake behind a continuous wooded bank strip; the east spurs face a narrow cove through trees. No site is named as lakeside on the county page; the CampLife site map/photos were not readable (the CampLife page returned only a JS shell), so no named site within ~50 m over open ground was found. A loop by the bay north of the campground (~40.6473,-89.0327) was not identified as camping.

fees.extra_person ($1 a night per adult beyond 2) is NOT on the current county page (only site fees and the $2 resident discount); provenance of fees has no method, so left as stored for the reviewer.
